BudgetIncreaseTarget.description: Identifies one caller/aggregate cost owner. id is the key, group or project UUID; installation has no id. key_route requires route; end-user targets require an existing project-scoped digest; attribution requires label and value. Extra target selectors are rejected. Supply connection/slot/route policies are not caller budget targets.

CreateBudgetIncreaseRequest.description: Adds a positive exact USD amount to an existing effective cap. Reason must be a single line. Default expiry is the current calendar-window end; later requested expiries are clipped to that end. At most eight active increases per owner/window; concurrent grants add together. Existing accrued and in-flight costs are unchanged. Authorization is keys plus project-manager access, or installation settings for the installation target.

BudgetIncrease.description: Auditable, installation-local exception. Applies only to its original period, and Valkey server time enforces expiration even without another authority refresh. Revocation follows normal authority freshness. Clearing a permanent cap makes the increase irrelevant; restoring it within this period retains the exception. This record and encrypted mutation replay contain only administrative metadata.

CreateBudgetIncreaseRequestRequest.description: Asks a reviewer to add a positive exact USD amount to a project budget cap in its current window. The request binds to that project, window and base cap, so a changed cap or a rolled window needs a new request. A signed-in project member may ask, and asking never changes serving limits.

BudgetIncreaseRequest.description: A member request for one temporary project budget increase. Pending, declined and expired requests never change serving limits, and a pending request reads as expired once its window has ended. Approval creates one normal budget increase, linked as increase_id, and no one may approve their own request.
